statement: Benchmarking Qwen2.5-Coder 7B and larger through Ollama's /api/generate endpoint yields invalid HumanEval+ scores — measured at 32.3% (7B) and 17.1% (14B) against 84.1% and 87.8% for the same weights served over an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

citations.supports_because: Records both sides of the comparison on one rig with the same weights and dataset, and the control that makes it a harness finding rather than a model finding: non-Qwen models (yi-coder:9b, deepseek-coder-v2:16b) scored correctly through the same Ollama path.

_confidence_note: Medium, not high: reproduced across two model sizes on one rig with a working control, but not isolated to a specific cause in Ollama, not filed upstream, and not re-tested against a later Ollama release. It is stated as an observed condition to design around (CAV-01), not as a diagnosis.
